- **Technology presets.** The campaign editor offers 18 new technologies,
  past, present and future, all from the game's research: the eleven in
  Rushing, Umeokolo & Xu (2025) plus Autonomous AI Agents, AI Vulnerability
  Mapping, Brain-Computer Interfaces, Neuro-cognitive Weapons, Quantum
  Computing and Cognitive Biotechnology (from the NATO Chief Scientist, NIU
  and NeuroStrike reports). Each shows its year, its S score
  and what it does in the game.
- **Build your own technology,** or customise a preset: name, year, era, the
  four attribute scores (low, medium, high) with the S total and whether the
  paper's model would flag it, the moves it boosts, +1 or +2 spread grades,
  and the special effects (no foothold needed; full strength on links).
- **A cleaner editor.** Tabs (Calendar, Story, Sides & Start, Headlines), a
  roomier calendar with + buttons on each week, and a tidier panel on the
  right with Blue and Olvana's crisis results on their own tabs.
- Technology names written by players are escaped everywhere they appear.

Full history: see What's new on the playtest page.
